info.name: Railway System - G5 Operations & Analytics
info.description: Task G5.6. Covers every Group 5 endpoint of contract C9. Run the folder 'Auth setup' first: it stores adminToken, passengerToken and operatorToken. Start the backend on port 8080 with the seed data loaded (C6). Dates ({{today}}, {{weekAgo}}, {{monthAgo}}) are computed by the collection pre-request script. Run 1 is train 11001 on the first seeded day; 'Operator status update' restores it to SCHEDULED so the collection can be run again.

'FLYING' is not one of SCHEDULED, ON_TIME, DELAYED, CANCELLED, ARRIVED.
sp_update_train_status raises RUN_NOT_FOUND for a run id that does not exist.
delayMinutes must be >= 0 (request DTO validation; the table also has CHECK(Delay_Minutes >= 0)).

exec: // Local (non-persistent) date variables used in URLs and bodies: {{today}}, {{weekAgo}}, {{monthAgo}}.
function fmt(d) { return d.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(d.getMonth() + 1) + '-' + pad(d.getDate()); }
function daysAgo(n) { const d = new Date(); d.setDate(d.getDate() - n); return fmt(d); }
